title: Payment Plan Confirmation — Home Delivery Pharmacy Account Tools
content:
## Desk reference: confirmation of a payment plan

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, when the member confirms a payment plan, the plan's length in months and its monthly installment are recorded on the account.

The installment terms are not fixed until the member has made the plan's down payment.

Put another way: until the member has made the plan's down payment, neither the plan's length nor its monthly installment is fixed.

**Effect.** The confirmed plan is recorded as a completed payment-plan request dated the day of confirmation, carrying the number of monthly installments and the installment amount, and the plan length is set on the account, so the plan is in force and the monthly installments are scheduled.

### Capability

`confirm_payment_plan_4c427b9b` confirms a payment plan on the member's own Northbridge Rx Home Delivery account. One call records the confirmed plan as a completed payment-plan request dated today with its months and installment, and sets the plan length on the account.

### How it is invoked

This is the member's own tool, which the customer themselves runs. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `confirm_payment_plan_4c427b9b`, handing it over to the member, who runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `mail_account_id` | the reference number of the member's home delivery account, as read to the member by the representative from the home delivery account lookup | identifier |
| `plan_months` | the number of monthly installments in the plan, exactly as the representative quoted it | integer count of at least 1 |
| `plan_monthly_amount` | the amount of each monthly installment, exactly as the representative quoted it | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places |

### Return

A successful call returns `plan_request_id` (the reference number of the confirmed payment plan), `plan_months` (the installments in the plan), `plan_monthly_amount` (each installment, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` "completed", meaning the plan is confirmed and in force on the account.
